description: PB-58 is the dedicated RTO code for the Dera Baba Nanak sub-division in Gurdaspur district, Punjab. The office, operating under the Sub-Divisional Magistrate, manages vehicle registrations, driving license issuances, and transport permit renewals for this strategically important border town.
address: Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) Office, Dera Baba Nanak, Gurdaspur, Punjab
